description:
In-use bytes = heap blocks owned by live processes + live off-heap binary buffers; the pool's free lists are reported separately. Telemetry, not a probe: every memory rule in the plan is judged in these bytes instead of peak RSS (malloc takes memory eagerly and returns it slowly). Files: runtime/src/heap/block_pool.rs, bits.rs, telemetry.rs, process.rs.

Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/Pqqu5yTcQdBbkGsZyZiykb (GC memory plan v3, approved by the user 2026-11-17).
title: The runtime reports the bytes its processes use and the bytes its pool keeps idle, at each collection and at exit
